text: {"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strncasecmp() decremented s1 instead of incrementing it, so the first string was walked backwards; changed `*s1--` to `*s1++`."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strcspn() walked the string backwards (--p) instead of forwards (++p), so it returned wrong lengths and failed the strspn KUnit test."}
